title: Promote a heading
text: The stars drop by one and the heading stays where it is in the text, so the siblings after it become its children.

title: Demote a heading
text: The heading and its subtree go one level deeper. After a sibling it becomes that sibling's last child.

title: Move a subtree
text: A heading changes places with its sibling, subtree and all.

title: A new item above sub-items
text: The new item goes right under the item's first line, and the sub-items follow it.

title: A new description item
text: The term is empty, ready to be filled in.
org:
* Terms
- org :: outliner
- pwa :: web app

title: Checking a box
text: A box that has boxes under it shows what they add up to, and the cookie follows.

title: Insert a table column
text: The table is aligned again and the =#+TBLFM:= references move with the columns.

title: Delete a table row
text: The other rows keep their layout, and row references in =#+TBLFM:= follow.

title: Change a table cell
text: The columns are widened to the longest cell.
